status_assessment.basis: A Christchurch diocesan publication dated 2 September 2026 advertised a Michaelmas service at the church for 29 September 2026. The diocese also advertised multiple Easter 2026 services there. No closure, final-service, sale, disposal, or deconsecration evidence was found in the accessible sources.
status_assessment.osm_stale_basis: The seeded OSM tags describe a Christian Anglican place of worship, consistent with the 2026 diocesan evidence. The OSM history and API pages were inaccessible, so individual object versions could not be checked.
